name: Recurring task nudger
description: Reads FRIDAY personal-desk tasks (passed in, or a JSON file) and lists overdue items that are not done. Never invents reminders. Report only until you approve recording the nudge.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY found {count} overdue personal-desk task(s) from your own data. This is a reminder list only — allow to keep it in the approval queue. Nothing will be marked done.
